name: Alchemical Blood Transcription
body:
School divination; Level alchemist 2/legendary alchemist 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components v, S, M (one ounce of blood from a dead spellcaster)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hour
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

By consuming 1 ounce of blood from a spellcaster (including alchemists and investigators) killed within the last 24 hours mixed into this extract upon its creation, you can attempt to learn a spell that spellcaster knew. Select one spell available to the dead spellcaster (this must be a spell on your spell list); you can spend 1 round to transcribe it into your formulae book.
